conclusion: The pipeline is reproducible, but the current retrospective evidence does not establish that sparse routing improves prediction or net performance over simpler models.
conclusionDetail: Average AUC is close to 0.51. Lower validation-selected cutoffs increase returns alongside much larger exposure; the paired return-difference intervals still include zero. A working model is not yet a validated strategy.
sample: 10 US stocks · 953 exchange sessions · 2023-01-03 to 2026-10-20 · USD adjusted-price units. SPY is retained as a benchmark input. The universe is fixed-current, dividends are absent and the history has already been examined.
timingSteps: 20 historical feature rows, ending at the signal close
Close plus 15 minutes: hypothetical feature availability
Entry at the next exchange open, once model readiness permits
Exit at the following exchange open
timingNote: Class 0 holds cash. Fitting and validation labels must finish before selection and entry; purged boundaries and an explicit readiness allowance prevent reuse of labels that have not finished. Availability is still a proxy, not independently certified publication time.
architectureIntro: Each expert is a complete LSTM that reads the same historical window. The router reads the last feature row and assigns weights. The model combines hidden representations and uses one shared output head; these are not independently calibrated expert forecasts.
routerLabel: Router: last feature row → linear layer → softmax
mixLabel: Flatten the sequence → weighted hidden mixture
headLabel: Shared scalar head → sigmoid probability, or fit-scaled return regression
routeNote: The route shown is illustrative, not a measured assignment to bull, bear or reversal regimes. Dense and equal modes process all three experts; top-2 dispatch sends a window only to the selected two. Fewer active experts do not guarantee faster execution.
dimensions: Each 20 × 64 expert sequence becomes 1,280 values. The default MoE has 59,682 parameters; the matched single LSTM uses 114 units and 59,748 parameters. This controls parameter budget without assuming equivalent optimization.
features: Opening gap, intraday movement and price range
Volume relative to its past average
featureNote: Ten relative OHLCV features are fitted and scaled only on the training segment. The gate directly sees the final feature row; it has no separate sequence encoder in this default design. Earlier history can still enter through rolling indicators. Manual/KMeans/SOM describe separate feature-selection experiments, not the identities of the three experts.
resultsIntro: The primary experiment and the new objective screen are separate studies. Compare models within the same study; they have different seed counts and training budgets. All headline returns below use 5 bps per one-way traded notional and include entry and terminal liquidation.
primaryScope: 7 rolling folds × 5 seeds; 35 cases per model. Average AUC/Brier skill summarizes cases. Returns are the median of seven fold values after averaging seeds within each fold; they are not annualized or a stitched NAV.
targetScope: 7 folds × 3 neural seeds; linear/prior models run once per fold. 140 fits and 175 total cases including common controls. Both schemes cap training at 30 epochs, batch 128, patience 5. Targets, loss and allocation hurdle change together.
targetPending: The objective screen has not yet published a completed result. No estimates are filled in.
baseline: Under the same fold-summary convention, always holding returns {holding}; the causal 10% volatility control returns {volatility}. Their realized risks differ. No exact test-period risk match is claimed.
exposureWarning: In the primary diagnosis, selected-rule mean opening exposure is about 85–87%, compared with about 6–15% for the original rules. More exposure and more return can occur together without more predictive information.
uncertaintyTitle: How uncertain is the threshold gain?
uncertainty: Selected threshold minus original rule, paired on the same market dates. All four intervals span zero. The 2,000 draws use 20-session blocks within folds and average seed differences before resampling. These are unadjusted exploratory intervals; repeated seeds do not create new market dates.
validationWarning: Threshold selection uses validation only, but that validation also informed early stopping. Regression scores are returns, not probabilities. No test-based winner selection or probability calibrator was fitted.

gateTitle: When is more MoE capacity worth trying?
gateIntro: Sparse fixed-rule performance must beat the linear, matched and equal controls at 5 bps with positive lower paired intervals, retain positive mean differences at 20 bps and win at least five of seven folds against each model. Prediction-loss improvement and a validation-exposure control must also pass.

gateStates.promising_retrospective: Promising retrospectively; forward evidence still required

gateNote: These frozen development checks are not a corrected statistical test. Even passing them does not authorize expansion or trading. All candidate/objective IDs remain in forward preparation without picking a historical winner.
limits: The six evidence gaps cover point-in-time membership, historical security identity, corporate actions, historical availability, owner/source-use provenance and holdout governance. Hash verification proves retained bytes, not the historical truth of these claims. Costs do not include dividends, financing or leverage.
forward: The modeled preparation window is 2026-11-09 through 2027-02-05: 61 signal sessions, followed by the two required opens. Preparation is frozen but blocked; it is not a registered holdout, accepted research or a collection schedule.
cryptoTitle: Crypto data and the next evidence question
crypto: A separate verified BTC/ETH hourly snapshot is now complete, with4h bars derived from contiguous hours. The older eight-product study and retained AIVIX factors remain daily, while the DEX hourly pilot remains blocked. These inputs describe different coverage and are not interchangeable.
sentiment: A future screen should compare price only, price plus causally available sentiment, and delayed/placebo controls. Record publication/retrieval time, revision behavior and missingness. A daily sentiment value must not be copied backward into earlier hourly decisions. Spot price studies and event-book maker simulations remain separate.
provenance: Only intentionally published aggregates appear here; raw prices, individual predictions and private artifact paths are not distributed. Detailed protocols and commands remain in the source repository.

methodChangesTitle: What changed from the original research script
methodChanges: Align feature, signal and next-open label clocks; class0 means cash, not a claim that price falls.
Include initial capital1 in drawdown peaks and charge initial entry, turnover and final liquidation.
Fit scalers and selectors only on fitting rows; purge unavailable labels and reserve model-readiness time.
Dispatch sparse windows only to selected experts; test fixed weights and expert removal separately from retraining.
Retain scores, feature order, checkpoints, routing and source/input digests so results can be reconstructed.
